title: Improving OCR Faithfulness via Gated and Attenuated On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2609.38282v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models may rewrite anomalous text in images into linguistically plausible expressions, compromising OCR transcription faithfulness. Sequence-level task rewards and local teacher guidance are complementary, but guidance from the same teacher may not remain equally effective as the student improves. Offline analysis shows that supervision from a fixed teacher becomes progressively less favorable as the student improves, both across training checkpoints and across response groups with different task rewards. Motivated by this observation, we introduce GAD-RL, which adaptively regulates teacher supervision during joint post-training according to the student's current task performance and local distributions. A frozen teacher conditions on reference transcriptions and student-generated prefixes. translated_title: 通过门控与衰减的在线策略蒸馏提升OCR忠实性
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型可能会将图像中的异常文本改写为语言学上看似合理的表达，从而损害OCR转录的忠实性。序列级任务奖励与局部教师指导是互补的，但来自同一教师的指导可能不会随着学生能力的提升而保持同等有效。离线分析表明，随着学生的改进，来自固定教师的监督在训练检查点之间以及不同任务奖励的响应组之间都逐渐变得不利。受这一观察启发，我们提出了GAD-RL，它在联合后训练过程中根据学生当前的任务表现和局部分布自适应地调节教师监督。一个冻结的教师模型以参考转录和学生生成的前缀为条件。GAD-RL对包含任务奖励不低于0.95的输出的响应组禁用蒸馏，并持续衰减蒸馏（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出GAD-RL方法，在联合后训练中根据学生模型当前的任务表现和局部分布，自适应地门控并衰减教师蒸馏信号，从而提升视觉-语言模型OCR转录的忠实性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GAD-RL, which adaptively gates and attenuates teacher distillation supervision based on the student's current task performance and local distributions, thereby improving the faithfulness of OCR transcription in vision-language models.
